subject: [PATCH v1 3/3] fuse: replace folio_test_highmem() with folio_test_partial_kmap()

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch replaces the use of folio_test_highmem() with folio_test_partial_kmap() in the fuse module's copy functionality. The change is necessary to ensure accurate handling of high memory mappings, particularly when using large folios and CONFIG_DEBUG_KMAP_LOCAL_FORCE_MAP is enabled. Without this change, fuse_copy_do() could copy past the end of a mapping on a highmem build with the mentioned configuration.
